title: Touch layouts reveal the Edit/Delete pill on long-press
context: The design's in-place manage menu is a dark pill that appears on pointer hover. The Android bottom-bar layout has no hover. The design's phone screens handle it inconsistently: no buttons on phone Today cards, always-visible buttons on phone day-modal cards.
options: Always-visible buttons on every compact card
outcome: Long-press reveals the same dark pill, chosen by the owner, so touch and pointer share one menu.
